title: Little Nightmares I & II Bundle
description: Little Nightmares I & II Bundle combines the original Little Nightmares and Little Nightmares II on Nintendo Switch. Both games focus on atmospheric exploration, environmental puzzles, stealth, and escape sequences in unsettling worlds viewed from a cinematic side-on perspective. The bundle is treated as a single Standard product because the seller listing contains only two account variants.

gameplayPillars.title: Atmosphere
gameplayPillars.description: Lighting, scale, sound, and unsettling environments drive the horror experience.

gameplayPillars.title: Environmental Puzzles
gameplayPillars.description: Progress depends on observation, traversal, object interaction, and timing.

gameplayPillars.title: Escape and Stealth
gameplayPillars.description: Many encounters focus on hiding, evasion, and surviving larger threats.

worldSummary: The bundle spans the Maw and the Pale City, surreal places inhabited by distorted adults, mysterious children, and dangerous creatures.

storyChapters.title: Six and the Maw
storyChapters.body: Little Nightmares follows Six as she tries to escape the Maw, a grotesque vessel inhabited by monstrous adults and other trapped children.

storyChapters.title: Mono and the Pale City
storyChapters.body: Little Nightmares II follows Mono and Six through the Pale City, where the Signal Tower and Thin Man distort the world around them.

storyChapters.title: Two Connected Nightmares
storyChapters.body: Together the games form a dark fairy-tale universe built around childhood fear, environmental storytelling, and recurring mysteries rather than conventional exposition.

handheld.notes: This bundle contains two separate games with different render profiles. Little Nightmares Complete Edition is officially specified at 720p upscaled/30 fps handheld and 720p native/30 fps TV. Little Nightmares II also targets 30 fps but can render lower in handheld mode. The aggregate fields therefore use a range rather than pretending both titles share one exact internal resolution.
